states.description: Bloom pass exists and its strength/threshold parameters are within cinematic target ranges (strength 0.3-3.0, threshold 0.0-1.0)

states.name: after_check_6
states.description: A floating control panel (HTML overlay or 3D plane) is present in the DOM or scene for adjusting effects

states.name: after_check_7

states.name: after_check_8
states.description: User can toggle bloom on/off via the control panel and the pass enabled state changes accordingly

states.name: after_check_9
states.description: The renderer output uses a tone mapping mode suitable for cinematic look (ACESFilmic, Cineon, or Reinhard) and exposure is set between 0.5 and 3.0

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["multi","asset","postprocess","006"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()
